selection: Eight locked never-matrix-exposed, public-safety-screened identities selected after isolated sealed boolean scoreability admission. H63 remains failure-accounting policy. Each shared trajectory pauses only after a candidate effect and later verification activity are each bound to successful exact-request receipts; the verification-confirming response is held without tool effects before cloning.
instrument_treatment: Validator-proven indeterminate calls debit their full admitted bound; affected pairs are symmetric zeros and later independent tasks continue.
treatment: At the effect-readiness boundary both arms receive the same neutral completion-review notice. Treatment alone receives one observable completion-readiness projection capped at eight evidence items, 4,096 bytes, and 1,024 provider-measured tokens. Both resume normal tools and reasoning under original limits.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and guidance-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
A validator-proven zero-byte indeterminate call is debited at its full admitted bound and its pair is retained as symmetric zeros.
Any unbounded usage, readiness-boundary, held-effect, ancestry, first-prompt, exposure, or token-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
